newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade thin, not well tested-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade thin, not well tested-USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steers sold for a market test, and no slaughter heifers sold, USDA said.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 100 slaughter steers early Monday. Week to date including late Friday and over the weekend on 5,400 head mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Pen Mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1250 lbs including longhorn cross and dairy cross 63.00.
